name: Table 1-9: Atmospheric Presence
_doc: Determines atmospheric thickness. Includes modifiers from Table 1-7 Gravity.

rows.name: None
rows.description: No atmosphere or so thin as to be effectively nonexistent. Treated as vacuum (RT Core p.262-263). No need to roll on Table 1-10.

rows.name: Thin
rows.description: Atmosphere is weak but avoids vacuum problems. Tests to avoid Toxic/Corrosive harm at +10 bonus. Lack of air makes strenuous activity difficult: outside-air-reliant Explorers gain Fatigue + 1 additional level.

rows.name: Moderate
rows.description: No ill effects from lack/overabundance of air, though can still be Toxic or Corrosive.

rows.name: Heavy
rows.description: Thick blanket of air. Imposes -5 on Strength or Toughness Tests (GM discretion). Toxic/Corrosive resistance tests at -10. If breathable: 1 hour reliance inflicts 1 Fatigue (not cumulative); recovery cannot occur while relying on this atmosphere.
